description: Datamängd för vägar 1:10 000 is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lantmäteriet. Dataset for roads and road points taken from the Swedish Transport Administration's products: Road Type, Road Obstacle, Resting Place and Turning Opportunity. Coverage: Lantmäteriet. The portal shows the English title as "Road dataset 1:10 000" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Lantmäteriet. The listing shows 1 download or service links in HTML. The listing shows 2026-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
